incident: dex-relay-pollution — 2 foreign receipts written into the foundry chain
rootCause: saos-dex instance started with inherited shell DATABASE_URL (foundry custom.db) overriding its own .env; the dex relay's reconcile queue (restored 12 anchor records from prior run) wrote 2 batch receipts (fromHeight 18-24, 25-36 — pre-reset dex chain) through its own prisma model (schema WITHOUT `at` column, digest = payload-only convention) into the foundry's EvidenceReceipt (at=NULL, foreign digest convention) — verifyChainDag digest+link errors followed. Caught by the mandatory post-task preflight re-check.
disposition: archived verbatim + removed from EvidenceReceipt; foundry schema hardened: EvidenceReceipt.at DateTime? → DateTime (required) so foreign writers structurally fail; dex now runs with explicit isolated DATABASE_URL
